misprints.note: No smooth breathing on the initial omicron in the print; kept as printed.
The print shows two colons after Uppmjuka where the book's usual separator is '.:'; kept as printed.
The period after the abbreviation m is missing in the print (there is a space before the comma); kept without the period.

uncertain.note: The OCR had a smooth breathing. At 450 dpi the mark looks like a rough breathing, and ἁμαρτάνειν is the correct form, so I changed all three standalone instances to ἁ. ἀφαμαρτάνειν keeps its smooth breathing.
The period after 'd' is very faint and set low, but it seems to be there.
There is a tiny dot at the baseline before the colon, so I read it as '.:'. It may be a dust speck.
